title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 151 Highway 74 South in Peachtree City, Georgia, as the "SFC Shawn McCloskey Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 151 Highway 74 South in Peachtree City, Georgia, as the SFC Shawn McCloskey Post Office.

summary.headline: A law renames the Postal Service facility at 151 Highway 74 South in Peachtree City, Georgia, as the SFC Shawn McCloskey Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This act gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Peachtree City, Georgia, an official name honoring SFC Shawn McCloskey. It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change how mail is delivered, what services the office offers, or who works there.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The act was enacted on January 4, 2025.
